packageName.description:
The name of the package for this query.
If empty, the performance test results for all packages will be returned.

repository.description:
The name of the repository for this query.
If empty, the performance test results for all repositories will be returned.

semanticVersion.description:
The semantic version for this query.
If empty, the performance test results for all versions will be returned.

Example: '7.10', '7', '7.10.2' or '7.10.2+1234'

testSuiteName.description:
The test suite name for this query.
If specified, only the performance test results with the specified test suite name will be returned.

testCaseName.description:
The test case name for this query.
If specified, only the performance test results with the specified test case name will be returned.

customMeasurementField.description:
The custom performance measurement field name for this query.
If specified, only the customer performance measurement results will be returned.

Example: '🛠 Custom Page Load Time'
